calculate_vsd_error: calculate the Visible Surface Discrepancy between estimated and ground-truth 6D object poses using a renderer
calculate_mssd_error: calculate the Maximum Symmetry-Aware Surface Distance between estimated and ground-truth poses for symmetric objects
calculate_add_error: calculate the Average Distance of Model Points between estimated and ground-truth poses for non-symmetric objects
calculate_adi_error: calculate the Average Distance of Surface Points using nearest neighbors for objects with indistinguishable views
calculate_cus_error: calculate the Complement over Union of projected 2D masks between estimated and ground-truth poses
